# R5 pilot: deaths in the window and the shared random sequence (generated by scripts/r5-deaths.ts; do not edit)

Every arm of a seed continues the same random sequence. "Very small value": a draw below 2000 ÷ 2^32 (4.7e-7). An animal dies at a slow step when its draw is below its death chance for that step, printed with each death.
